politeAccess: HTTPS only, no credentials; at most one request start per 1.1 s per host (serial per-host queue), bounded envelopes and counts; outFields limited to native-ID, object-ID and ID-part fields.

endpointMetadata.descriptionExcerpt: This is a statewide data layer aggregated from our individual county parcel datasets. Update information can be found within the layer’s attributes and in a table on the Utah Parcel Data webpage under Basic Parcels. "Database containing parcel boundary, parcel identifier, parcel address, owner type, and county recorder contact information" - HB113. The intent of the bill was to not include any att

identity.choice: No statewide parcel key is published; PARCEL_ID is each county recorder's number, so County+PARCEL_ID (composite) is the native key. Populated and unique per key in Salt Lake City; in Provo (Utah County) 104 of 813 keys span several rows, which are parts of one parcel (parts mode).

coverageCaveats: Some counties publish one parcel as several touching or disjoint rows (observed in Utah County, Provo); all components are fetched and dissolved by polygon union. Rows sharing one key can overlap (Provo samples: 0.003, 0.91, 3.87 and 41.4 m², the last being most of a 71 m² row of Utah~180100174), so disjointParts is not set and the union absorbs the overlap; this is assembly of the publisher rows for one key, not a boundary repair.
Rows with null or blank PARCEL_ID (24,063 statewide on 2026-10-12) are excluded.
Same endpoint as us-ut-salt-lake-city-parcels (County=SaltLake, key PARCEL_ID under US-UT-SALTLAKE-); Salt Lake County parcels would exist under both namespaces.
Layer also publishes address, owner type and account fields, which are not requested.
